Blue Nile presents The Rumble ft. Big Chief Joesph Boudreaux Jr. 
Ain’t No Dying VINYL RELEASE PARTY
categories: Music - R&B, Funk, Brass Band, MG Indian
events.description:
Venue: Blue Nile
Starts: 2026-10-17T23:00:00.000-05:00
Categories: Music - Cajun, Zydeco, Music - R&B, Funk, Brass Band, MG Indian, Music - Rock, Pop, Roots, Cover, Music - Classical, Music - Jazz & Blues, Music - Acoustic, Songwriter, Ethnic, Music - Other
More info: https://www.bluenilelive.com/
Tickets: https://www.showpass.com/the-rumble-ft-big-chief-joesph-boudreaux-jr-oct-2026/

Saturday October 17 

Doors 10PM / Show 11PM

On Mardi Gras morning, your eyes may feast on the intricate and elaborate beadwork of the Indians as they dance down the street, but the first thing you'll hear when they make their way toward you is the back line, known as "the rumble". Featuring seven GRAMMY-nominated musicians, The Rumble is more than just a band — it's an opportunity to be immersed in a wholly unique facet of New Orleans culture. Composed of Second Chief Joseph Boudreaux Jr. of the Golden Eagles, trumpeter Aurélien Barnes, trombonist José Maize Jr., bassist TJ Norris, guitarist Ari Teitel, keyboardist Andriu Yanovski, and drummer Trenton O’Neal, the group fuses iconic New Orleans funk in the vein of The Meters and The Neville Brothers — but updated, modern and vibrant befitting the next generation — with electrifying brass and the singular visual splendor of the Black Masking carnival tradition. 

Advance Tickets $20

Reserved Seating $30

Venue: The Howlin' Wolf
Starts: 2026-11-19T17:00:00.000-06:00
Categories: Comedy
Tickets: www.thehowlinwolf.com

Now celebrating 16 years at the Howlin Wolf.  It is the Premier comedy show in the city. Comedy Gumbeaux Comedy Gumbeaux is considered a pro/am show. Is divided into three segments. The first segment is called the rising stars where those who are new to comedy or new to Comedy Gumbeaux get to perform their best three minute sets. Then the pros take over this is where season vets, touring comics and some national and even international comedians hit the stage. The third and final segment is for our drop ins. Anyone who may arrive a little late that would like to drop in and do sometime. You don’t wanna miss the fun.

The Big Damn Show began as a One Night Only event that, by popular demand, is now a monthly revue show.  The show is hosted and produced by JuJu and Odd Corey, a magic and sideshow duo specializing in hilariously strange and bizarre magic and dangerous stunts like fire eating and sword swallowing.  Every month features multiple special guests ranging from knife throwers to burlesque dancers and drag performers.
